text: So, this is our first day in New York. What shall we do?
Well, how about going to the Metropolitan Museum of Art? People say it's really good.
I'd rather not do that today. The weather's great. I want to be outside.
OK, well... why don't we go to the Statue of Liberty?
That's a good idea. And afterwards what about going to Central Park?
Sure. That sounds great. Oh, and I want to go to Times Square as well.
That's fine with me. Let's go there first. It's not far from here.
